paragraphs.text: A doun is a kithkin village or town found in Shadowmoor . The Lorwyn counterpart of a doun is called a clachan .
Doun is Scots for "down", as in a hill.
Ballygol - population wiped out by the elves of the Dusklight Safehold .
Ballynock - A haven for hunters and trappers. Trapper's Square
Barrenton ( 2 cards ) - Known for their Barrenton Cragtreads and Barrenton Medic . Barrenton's guard-captain was named Bowen . Its clachan equivalent is Burrenton .
Bristlebane - Home to the Hound of Bristlebane and the most violent douns in Shadowmoor. Even among kithkin, Bristlebane is considered dangerous.
Greymeadow - ringed by three layers of walls and gates, home of Wyb Cobbik , Betrys Cobbik , Gwyb Cobbik , Kypper Cobbik , Eswyn , Dagub , Cefin , Potrig , and the Kennies .
Kinscaer - home of Donal Alloway . Its clachan equivalent is Kinsbaile .
Mistmeadow - home of Jack Chierdagh and Keely Welk , ruled by Cenn Molla Welk . Its clachan equivalent is Goldmeadow .
Thistledown - its clachan equivalent is Cloverdell .
